description: Phase 6bf gate — ALTER TABLE subset: RENAME TABLE, RENAME COLUMN, ADD COLUMN. Mainline SQLite-compatible catalog mutations.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t1 (a INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1), (2);
ALTER TABLE t1 RENAME TO t2;
SELECT a FROM t2 ORDER BY a;
SELECT a FROM t1;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20);
ALTER TABLE t RENAME COLUMN a TO id;
SELECT id, b FROM t ORDER BY id;
SELECT a FROM t;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2);
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN b INTEGER;
SELECT a, b FROM t ORDER BY a;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2);
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN b TEXT DEFAULT 'x';
SELECT a, b FROM t ORDER BY a;
